entries.title: Psalms 79:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; Your holy temple they have defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

entries.title: Psalms 79:2
segments: The dead bodies of Your servants They have given [as] food for the birds of the heavens, The flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 79:3
segments: Their blood they have shed like water all around Jerusalem, And [there was] no one to bury [them].

entries.title: Psalms 79:4
segments: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and derision to those who are around us.

entries.title: Psalms 79:5
segments: How long, LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 79:6
segments: ¶Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You, And on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 79:7
segments: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his dwelling place.

entries.title: Psalms 79:8
segments: Oh, do not remember former iniquities against us! Let Your tender mercies come speedily to meet us, For we have been brought very low.

entries.title: Psalms 79:9
segments: Help us, O God of our salvation, For the glory of Your name; And deliver us, and provide atonement for our sins, For Your name's sake!

entries.title: Psalms 79:10
segments: Why should the nations say, "Where [is] their God?" Let there be known among the nations in our sight The avenging of the blood of Your servants [which has been] shed.

entries.title: Psalms 79:11
segments: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; According to the greatness of Your power Preserve those who are appointed to die;

entries.title: Psalms 79:12
segments: And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 79:13
segments: So we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, Will give You thanks forever; We will show forth Your praise to all generations.
